notes.title: Isle Of Ewe 1.1 Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It has been so exciting to share Isle Of Ewe with the world. We are so grateful to have received such positivity when so many of you have run into major issues partway through the game.

Before we launched, we did all we could add saving and loading as a feature. Unfortunately, our original implementation was nowhere near the quality that it should have been, which led to major and minor issues in various parts of the game.

The save system has been completely reworked from scratch, so most of the issues users have reported so far should never be seen again. This might lead to some unexpected behaviour when loading old save games for a small subset of players. Thank you so much for your feedback and patience thus far.

Happy herding!
